name: article
description: Constrained reading-width page with title header and optional share bar. Share bar is on by default; opt out per-page with share_bar: false in a :::settings block.

detect.note: .share-bar was removed from this list on 2026-07-28 when its CSS moved to themes/_base/assets/css/base.css, which loads unconditionally — the shape no longer owns those classes, so there is nothing here to gate. .visitor-count stays: this stylesheet DOES own it, while themes/_base/partials/visitor-count.njk can render it on a page that is not article-shaped. Rule: list what this stylesheet owns, never what this shape's renderer emits.
